title: The foundation - Scripture
summary: Explore the source of Adventist beliefs and how Adventists understand divine revelation.
detail: The project materials introduce the Bible as the foundation Adventists use to understand their beliefs. They invite readers to consider how Scripture was written and studied, and how it points to Jesus.

title: The beginning - Creation
summary: Explore creation, human dignity and purpose, care for creation, and the Sabbath as God's gift.
detail: The supplied lessons follow the Genesis creation account, including the creation of humanity and the seventh-day Sabbath. The project mission connects this belief with human dignity, purpose, and care for creation.

title: The problem - The Great Controversy
summary: Explore the Adventist explanation of suffering, evil, and the conflict between good and evil.
detail: This belief uses a biblical story of conflict between good and evil to explain why suffering exists. The supplied lesson follows the story from the choices in Eden to the promise of a coming deliverer.

title: The solution - Christ
summary: Explore Jesus Christ's ministry, death, resurrection, ascension, and Second Coming.
detail: The project materials present Jesus as God becoming human and describe his life, ministry, death, resurrection, ascension, and promised return. This topic introduces the role of Jesus in the Adventist understanding of salvation and hope.

title: The future - Death and Resurrection
summary: Explore the state of the dead, the resurrection, and the Christian hope of eternal life.
detail: The supplied Fundamental Belief 26 lesson presents death as a sleep and points to the resurrection at Jesus’ return as the Christian hope. This summary describes the Adventist teaching in the course material; it is not a comparison with other faiths.
